faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before getting started.

items.a: No. The subscription is monthly with no commitment: you can cancel at any time with 30 days' notice. There are no setup fees.

items.q: How long until my AI agent is live?
items.a: 48 hours on average. After the strategy call, we configure your agent (scripts, integrations, voice), test it with you, then put it into production.

items.q: Who installs and maintains the system?
items.a: We do. Airia configures, hosts, monitors and continuously improves your agents. There is nothing for you to install or maintain.

items.q: What happens if the AI can't answer?
items.a: The agent transfers to a human or takes a message as soon as a request falls outside its scope. Every call is transcribed and summarized — nothing gets lost.

items.q: Is my data and my clients' data protected?
items.a: Yes. Processing is GDPR-compliant and hosted with providers offering adequate safeguards. Details are in our privacy policy.
The voice receptionist starts at €350/month, with no setup fees. Combined solutions (lead gen, Meta ads, multilingual) are quoted based on your volume and tools.

items.q: Does the agent speak Dutch or English?
items.a: Yes — French, Dutch, English and German, with automatic detection of the caller's language.
